answer: A time-locked staking protocol deters Sybil attacks by requiring agents to deposit escrowed capital before transacting. As consensus challenges wander across the gossip topology, validators audit stake proofs to ensure the network offers no haven to unbonded entities. To forge multiple identities, an adversary must commit scarce liquid currency per node, driving capital efficiency to its nadir. However, this requirement excludes underfunded agents and advantages wealthy cartels.
